title: Sectionwise image of the composite proper-support inclusion
statement: Let f:X->Y and g:Y->Z be separated locally finite type morphisms, F a sheaf of Lambda-modules, and V etale over Z [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Construct the literal proper-support sheaf and its inclusion as in [lem-cbc-proper-support-section-calculus]. The composite inclusion g_!supp(f_!supp F)->g_*f_*F->(fg)_*F has on V exactly the sections with support proper over V [def-cbc-etale-section-proper-support, def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

proof.text: For a section supported properly over Y_V, its support T has closed image I in Y_V. The support of the corresponding section of f_!supp F is exactly I: off I the section vanishes; a zero germ on I would give a zero neighbourhood whose inverse image misses T, a contradiction.

If T is proper over V, the proper-over-separated lemma makes it proper over Y_V, and proper closed image makes I proper over V. Conversely if T is proper over Y_V and I proper over V, apply proper inverse image to T_red->Y_V and I; its inverse image is all of T_red, so T is proper over V.

The ordinary direct-image compositor identifies the underlying sections. Its restriction compatibility carries the preceding support calculation to the chosen pullback objects. Use the shared proper_iso_image theorem of support locality to transport closed-support properness across the pullback compositor isomorphism; the geometric-germ restriction formula transports its support criterion.

theorem properSupportComposite_range (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Z.Etale)
    (s : F.obj.obj (op ((f ≫ g).Etale.obj V))) :
    (∃ t, (((properSupportLowerStarInclusion Λ g).app
          ((properSupportLowerStar Λ f).obj F) ≫
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).map
          ((properSupportLowerStarInclusion Λ f).app F) ≫
        (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f g).hom.app F).hom.app (op V)) t = s) ↔
      SectionHasProperSupport Λ F ((f ≫ g).Etale.obj V) (pullback.fst V.hom (f ≫ g)) s
